dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: So far, I've taken care of quite a few hilichurls and slimes, but there's always more of them...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: They've been appearing more frequently of late. I cannot allow them to get any closer to Mondstadt. My lover Glory is...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: ...No, it's nothing. Thanks for listening to me. Stay safe on your travels. Here's some of the experience I've gained out in the wild — I hope it'll be useful to you.
